board_ref: 23 axes / 22 measured / 1 UNMEASURED slot (effect-binding), fetched live from https://councilof.ai/api/gspc on 2026-09-20
stop_rule: Every row is CANDIDATE_UNMEASURED. No row may flip to MEASURED until the pinned instrument, deterministic grader, complete denominator, run output, and signed card all exist and reconcile. Measurement is never certification.
doctrine: Map to existing GSPC axes only; no new axis is proposed here.
Asset performance (yield, TVL change, price) is never governance quality and feeds no axis.
ADR-003 (axis 24, issued-supply) is DRAFT and not ruled; supply observations are held off-board.
effect-binding is a declared UNMEASURED slot in the model-comparison family; nothing in this pack maps to it.

proposed_instruments.sketch: Grade per attestation period: document present, hash-pinned, attestor named, period stated, ratio fields internally consistent, period contiguous with prior (market-holiday calendar applied). The USDY (Ondo USDY LLC) daily+monthly inventory already exists as rerun-reproducible input (ondo-attestation-inventory.json). Verdicts PASS / FAIL / UNCHECKABLE per period; unreachable is UNCHECKABLE, never FAIL.
proposed_instruments.denominator: All attestation periods the issuer claims to publish, for EVERY issuing entity — currently known: Ondo USDY LLC daily (744 files, 2023-09-28..2026-09-15) and monthly (36 files, 2023-09..2026-08), INCOMPLETE until the OGM (BVI) series (GAP-09), OUSG NAV reports (GAP-01c) and Ondo Stocks Ankura attestations (GAP-08) are included; missing periods count as explicit gaps, never dropped.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: That attestation documents prove reserve sufficiency, solvency, or redemption capacity. Mechanism pinned (Dropbox/Drive/Ankura surfaces); document bytes not yet pinned.

proposed_instruments.sketch: For every docs-claimed contract address on every claimed chain: read-only eth_call-equivalent readback (code-exists, name, symbol) at a pinned block, compared against the docs assertion; plus hash-pinned audit PDFs with auditor/date extracted. Rehearsed here for OUSG Ethereum only (4 of 4 selectors agree at retrieval time; block not pinned).
proposed_instruments.denominator: Every address asserted on docs.ondo.finance/addresses across every claimed chain, plus every audit PDF linked from docs.ondo.finance/audits.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: That docs-chain agreement proves authentic issuance authority (see REJ-06).

proposed_instruments.sketch: Inventory custody disclosures (custodian names, custodian addresses, legal-structure statements) across product docs; grade disclosure presence and internal consistency; every custodian attribution that is not publicly checkable is recorded as UNCHECKABLE, not failed.
proposed_instruments.denominator: Every custody-related disclosure field found in the frozen docs set.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: That disclosure of a custodian proves custody is actually performed as described.

proposed_instruments.sketch: Cross-check redemption-rail and chain-availability disclosures across product pages, docs and contract-address tables; grade completeness and consistency of what is disclosed. Behavioural verification (executing mints/redemptions) is excluded by doctrine: no wallet, no transaction.
proposed_instruments.denominator: Every product x chain x rail combination the docs assert.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: That disclosed redemption rails execute as described.

proposed_instruments.sketch: Freeze regulatory self-descriptions (Regulation S reliance, non-US redemption restriction, affiliate/ecosystem boundary) as versioned citations; grade citation stability across re-fetches. Legal mapping stays separate from technical behaviour; no legal determination is produced.
proposed_instruments.denominator: Every regulatory self-description field found in the frozen docs set.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: Any legal or regulatory determination about the issuer.

proposed_instruments.target_axis: issued-supply (ADR-003 DRAFT — NOT A BOARD AXIS)
proposed_instruments.sketch: Per-block-pinned totalSupply readback for OUSG and USDY on every claimed chain, modelled on public/interop/xrpl-supply-2026-09-16.json. Held entirely off-board: ADR-003 is a draft and no axis 24 exists on the live board.
proposed_instruments.denominator: Every token contract x chain with a successful identity pin.
proposed_instruments.never_claims: That issued supply is reserve backing or board evidence of anything.
